title: tc-citation-badge
description:
A small badge of citation counts by kind – Publications, Supporting, Mentioning, Contrasting – with a tooltip
that says what each means, and an optional link to the details.

counts.description: Each kind's count by id: { publications: 522, supporting: 29 … }; a kind without one shows 0

rows.description: The kinds, in order; by default Publications, Supporting, Mentioning and Contrasting

layout.description: "labelled": name, mark and count; "compact": the mark and the count

source.description: A source's name shown on top, e.g. your index's name; none by default

label.description: What the counts are, for the badge's name when there's no `source`

href.description: Where the details are – the badge becomes a link

openable.description: Without `href`, makes the badge a button that fires tc-open

detailsLabel.description: The link's hint in the tooltip

locale.description: The language for numbers, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

icon.description: A built-in mark or an element to show (cloned)

meaning.description: What this kind means, for the tooltip: "cites this work as evidence for its claim"
